description: Representação conceitual, não anatomia literal: faísca divina dentro da alma e anexos que armazenam divindade. O número e a forma dos anexos desenhados não definem uma regra.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story / conceptual soul anatomy, original landscape 3:2 painterly RPG rulebook illustration for Nihility, Game Master's secret cosmology chapter about Titles, faith and divinity. Represent a soul as a softly bounded vast volume of PALE WHITISH energy, an ocean-like field of softly flowing pearl-white currents, not physical water and not a human ghost. Show a calm conceptual cutaway: in the deeper soul energy, a tiny enduring golden spark subtly holds the white currents together. On a visible outer part of this soul, several smaller translucent annex-like reservoirs are ATTACHED to its perimeter by short broad necks of soul energy, clearly extensions rather than detached floating objects. Within these annexes, different amounts of concentrated warm golden divine energy are stored. The annexes are the Titles, batteries of divinity outside the mortal soul's limited central capacity. The composition must make the relationship between pale soul, tiny sustaining divine spark and attached golden-energy reservoirs readable without text. Delicate distant warm lights suggest faith being sent across space, but do not depict or prescribe a specific routing between one worshipper and one reservoir. No circuit rings around the spark (that form is reserved for Skills), no orbitting glyphs, crowns, medallions, religious icons, halos, angel wings, eyeballs or deity portrait. Confident traditional acrylic and gouache brushwork, ivory and pearl-gray soul energy, pale cool shadows, restrained gold concentrated in the spark and annexes, light warm-white page background, generous negative space and soft painterly edges. Complex conceptual subject handled with simple large readable forms and selective fine detail. No glossy CGI, black background, overexposed bloom, floating UI, measuring scales, labels, text, logos or numbers. This is a conceptual illustration, not a literal mapped shape of every soul.
